points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable 17a5ef3 CMake build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes; CTest found no tests. Historical executable is not bound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:34–35 accepts --restart but solver.cpp:23–27 only stores it and no read implementation exists; output.cpp:441–450 writes only rank-zero-owned state. Case-driven parsing and error paths exist.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case_def, mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, solver and output units support case-driven extension; Solver holds substantial coupled state.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Reviewed source has an in-repository FV implementation; no call to external CFD solver executable was found. Trust policy excludes exhaustive external similarity/authorship investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp consumes a case path and case_def.cpp parses case JSON; no two-filename-only branch found. Viscous high-Mach CFL is hard capped in solver.cpp:649–656 and is a control limitation.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:61 uses METIS and neighbor halos exist, but solver.hpp:64 and solver.cpp:165–205 retain a complete global mesh on every rank throughout iterations; no valid controlled np1/np8 comparison established.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Recovered M0.15 inviscid/laminar histories are strongly unstable; selected M2 inviscid point field has Mach maximum 3.166e15. Do not apply stale report billion-scale laminar numbers to recovered cases.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Independent validator passed all eight recovered cases and report yet accepted eight empty final-field sentinels; clean build succeeds but CTest finds no tests. Valid numerical or rank-consistency demonstration remains lacking.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular C++ with lengthy disputed force-sign commentary and an unused steady innerIters variable; three debug-only source files removed by curated commit.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: flux.cpp:16–50 and :81–87 implement nondimensional perfect-gas primitive/conservative conversion and Euler flux; result accuracy is assessed separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads CGNS zones and tags, resolves interzone interfaces, and constructs face adjacency. No independent exact geometric verification establishes all mesh accuracy.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:451–554 forms face fluxes with viscous contributions and uses MPI reductions; force instabilities and lack of controlled validation limit demonstrated quality.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:115 onward supplies Roe/Harten entropy correction and Rusanov fallback; high-Mach viscous mode forces Rusanov in solver.cpp:649–656.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:372–405 uses freestream inflow and extrapolated outflow, slip reflection and mirrored adiabatic no-slip velocity. This is a simplified farfield treatment.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.hpp defaults secondOrder true; solver.cpp:420–438,486–519 uses Green–Gauss gradients and reconstructed face states. No measured smooth-grid convergence order and historical executable is unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:420–438 computes Barth limiter and :486–519 applies it; reconstructed positivity fallback and update scaling exist. No independent production fallback statistics.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: flux.cpp:216–236 implements Newtonian stress and heat flux, and solver.cpp:1030–1036 estimates tangential wall shear. Selected laminar force histories drift or oscillate and do not establish credible convergence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:576–636 executes a local-time point-implicit diagonal update, not full lower/upper sweeps; report.tex:763 explicitly discloses this. The stated multiple steady sweeps do not occur.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 history and inner loop exist; solver.cpp:743–748 caps inner iterations at 15 and :845–852 counts ratio>=1 misses despite target 0.001. Recovered last ratio 0.928488; actual strict miss total is unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition and neighbor exchange are implemented, but persistent full mesh exists on each rank during iteration; historical np1 result histories are empty/failed, so rank consistency is not established.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight f9b3d2d field_final.vtu files are 474-byte empty placeholders; separate rank point-sample VTUs exist. Restart write is rank-zero local only and read is absent. Validator nevertheless accepts structure.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Fresh read-only benchmark validation of all eight f9b3d2d case directories and historical report directory returns OK, including empty final-field files. Structural acceptance does not prove physics.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Recovered M0.15 histories unstable, M080/M2 laminar and Re20 drag drift, Re200 last ratio 0.928488 and late-force behavior lacks credible shedding, despite successful metadata.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd 0.338 is low and drifting; M2 inviscid sample field has Mach maximum 3.166e15; force histories are not settled. Billion-scale laminar values in report are stale, not selected checkpoint results.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical PDF has missing-figure placeholders; independently delivered nested residual/force and centroid-sample plots exist. Re200 has a readable late force plot, showing drift, rather than no late-force figure.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report table has stale and sign-inverted values versus selected f9b3d2d forces, missing figures, and claims no mesh replication despite source. The explicit diagonal-implicit disclosure is credited.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Historical table differs from recovered forces and figure manifest names empty field_final.vtu although separate rank fields contain centroid samples. Exact historical executable and some plot generation bindings remain unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: 4/4 documented clean source build succeeds; 1.25/2 case CLI handles inputs but --restart is accepted without loading state; 0.25/2 output: all eight required field_final.vtu are empty sentinels and restart is only rank-zero state; 1/2 errors are caught but success statuses are unreliable.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: 3.5/4 CGNS zones/tags; 1.5/2 geometry; 1.5/2 mixed/multizone and family handling; 1.5/2 cell-face adjacency. mesh.cpp reads zones and merges interfaces; no independent exact geometric verification or controlled mesh accuracy test establishes full credit.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: 4/5 face FV residual; 3/4 Roe/Harten and Rusanov fallback; 2.5/3 farfield/slip; 2/3 no-slip adiabatic. solver.cpp:451–554 and flux.cpp implement the paths, but unstable force histories and lack of controlled verification limit demonstrated robustness.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: 3/4 Green–Gauss linear reconstruction; 2.5/3 Barth limiter active in solver.cpp:420–438,486–519; 1.5/2 positivity fallback; 0/1 no convergence-order verification. Historical executable binding remains uncertain.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: 2/3 primitive velocity/temperature gradients, 2/3 Newtonian stress/Fourier heat flux (reconstruction.cpp:72–125, flux.cpp:216–236), 1/2 no-slip wall treatment, 1/2 tangential wall shear (solver.cpp:1030–1036). Selected laminar forces drift or oscillate; do not attribute stale report billion-scale values to them.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: 2.5/4 local-time implicit steady march with viscous CFL cap, 2.5/4 documented diagonal point-implicit solver, 2/4 BDF2 history and dual loop but capped at 15 inner iterations, 0/3 wrong 1.0 miss threshold and misleading convergence fraction rather than 0.001 target. Report explicitly discloses diagonal approximation; actual strict miss count unknown.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: 1.5/2 METIS and owned/ghost partitions; 1.5/3 neighbor halo exchange but full global mesh persists on every rank throughout iterations; 1.5/2 reductions; 1/1 per-rank output discipline; 0/2 no valid rank comparison: selected np1 packages fail at step zero with empty force histories.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: 0.5/2 inviscid results with substantial instability and Mach outlier; 0.25/2 laminar attempts with drifts; 0.25/2 low and drifting Re20 drag; 0/2 Re200 lacks credible shedding; 0/1 empty required final fields and huge Mach sample; 0/1 failed np1 comparisons.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: 0.5/1 equations/method description with important contradictions and diagonal disclosure; 0.5/1 delivered nested histories but incomplete main report; 0.25/1 centroid-sample fields and missing main figures; 0/1 stale signs/values and false success analysis; 0.25/1 inaccurate field source manifest and missing reproducible main assets.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: 1.5/2 case-driven physics interface, 0.5/1 boundary organization, 0.5/1 mesh abstraction is explicitly 2-D, 0.5/1 modular source supports extensions but would need significant refactoring.
